en.headline: Fire at Tsuen Wan restaurant sends thick smoke into nearby streets
en.dek: About 20 employees and diners evacuated a ground-floor restaurant in Hau Tei Square around 5.14pm after heavy smoke was reported; firefighters extinguished the blaze.
body: A fire broke out at a ground-floor restaurant at 74-78 Hau Tei Square in Tsuen Wan at about 5.14pm on Wednesday after multiple callers reported heavy smoke rising from the premises.

Around 20 employees and diners evacuated promptly. Video shared online showed dense smoke billowing into the air, drifting towards a nearby building under scaffolding and spreading in the direction of Tai Ho Road.

Firefighters arrived and brought the blaze under control. Initial reports indicated no injuries at the scene. Preliminary information suggested the fire may have started from a stove flame in the restaurant.
Police and the Fire Services Department are investigating the cause of the incident.

zh.headline: 荃灣鱽地坊餐廳起火 濃煙湧向附近街道
zh.dek: 下午約5時14分，鱽地坊一間地舖餐廳冒出濃煙，約20名職員及食客疏散，消防到場將火救熄。
body: 星期三下午約5時14分，荃灣鱽地坊74至78號一間地下餐廳發生火警，多名市民報稱現場冒出濃煙。
約20名餐廳職員及食客迅速疏散。網上片段顯示濃煙衝天，隨風飄向附近有棚架的大廈，並向大河道方向擴散。
消防到場後將火勢撲滅。初步消息指現場無人受傷，初步資料顯示火警可能由餐廳爐頭搶火引起。
警方及消防處正調查事件起因。
